$comment: Bosses whose kill is counted only by Combat Achievements' NPC-death count (plugins/achievements/combatachievements/Kills.CombatAchievements.js) and whose own plugin says nothing. Live OSRS tells the player "Your <boss> kill count is: N." on every kill (Wiki, each boss's page). Keys are the dying NPC's name; values the Combat Achievements monster whose count is told. A boss whose plugin tells its own count (Zulrah, Cerberus, the GWD generals, Nex, Muspah, ...) must not be listed here.
